spans.s: 1. र the 2nd semivowel (corresponding to the vowels ऋ and ॠ, and having the sound of r in ring).
3. र mfn. (√ रा) acquiring, possessing, Naiṣ.
brightness, splendour (used in explaining an etymology), L.

1. रा or रास् cl. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 49) रा॑ति (Ved. also Ā. राते॑; Impv. रिरीहि, ररास्व, ररीध्वम्; p. रराण; 3. sg. र॑रते and रासते; pf. ररिम॑, ररे॑; aor. अ॑रास्म Subj. रा॑सत् &c. Pot. रासीय; Class. forms are only pr. राति; fut. राता, BhP.; रास्यति, Vop., and inf. रातवे, BhP.), to grant, give, bestow, impart, yield, surrender, RV.; &c.
